correctness.rationale: The three cases according to how many parts contain label 2 are exhaustive. For a unique 2-containing part, zeros in that part are impossible and an outside positive vertex is exactly what prevents every 2 from being isolated in the positive support. When at least two parts contain 2, every zero sees a 2 outside its part and every 2 sees another positive vertex outside its part. The polynomial follows by direct product counting. Exhaustive definition-level checking confirms all coefficients through order nine.
